```{python}
#| label: fig-sequential-hold-violation
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "A hold violation. `D` takes the value `b` in time, but changes to the next value `c` less than $t_\\text{hold}$ after the rising clock edge (red), i.e., inside the window of @fig-sequential-ff-timing. The next value arrives too early. From $t_\\text{cq}$ after the edge, `Q` is undefined (hatched): it may show `b` or `c`, and it may become metastable and settle only after an unpredictable time."
#| fig-alt: "Timing diagram with the rows clk, D, and Q around one rising clock edge, marked by a dashed line. A shaded window starts t_su before the edge and ends t_hold after it. D changes from a to b before the window and from b to c inside the window, one step after the edge. A red arrow from the edge to this change is labeled less than t_hold. Q shows the old value and becomes undefined, drawn hatched, t_cq after the edge. Blue arrows below the rows mark t_su and t_hold."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import logic
from schemdraw import elements as elm
from schemdraw.util import Point
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

BLUE = '#6c8ebf'
RED = '#b85450'
waves = {'signal': [
    {'name': 'clk', 'wave': '0.......1.......', 'period': 0.5},
    {'name': 'D', 'wave': '=..=.....=......', 'period': 0.5, 'data': ['a', 'b', 'c']},
    {'name': 'Q', 'wave': '=..........x....', 'period': 0.5, 'data': ['old']},
], 'config': {'hscale': 1}}

S = 0.8   # one time step in drawing units
LY = 0.45  # label baseline below its arrow


def x(step):
    return step*S + 0.04


def span(xa, xb, y, text, color=BLUE):
    ''' Arrow from xa to xb with a label below '''
    elm.Line(arrow='<->').at((xa, y)).to((xb, y)).color(color).linewidth(1.2)
    elm.Label().at(((xa + xb)/2, y - LY)).label(text, color=color)


with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as dr:
    dr.config(fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white', margin=0.15)
    elm.Rect(corner1=(x(5), -0.45), corner2=(x(10), -1.35), fill='#eaf1fb', lw=0).color('#eaf1fb')
    td = logic.TimingDiagram(waves, ygap=0.5, risetime=0.1, yheight=0.8, fontsize=11, namecolor='black',
                             grid=False)
    for seg in td.segments:
        if getattr(seg, 'align', None) == ('right', 'bottom'):   # signal names, onto the wave centers
            seg.xy = Point((seg.xy[0], seg.xy[1] + 0.2))
    elm.Line().at((x(8), 1.0)).to((x(8), -3.0)).color('#A6A6A6').linestyle('--').linewidth(1)
    elm.Line().at((x(9), -1.35)).to((x(9), -3.3)).color(RED).linestyle(':').linewidth(1)
    span(x(8), x(9), -3.3, '$< t_\\mathrm{hold}$', RED)
    span(x(5), x(8), -4.3, '$t_\\mathrm{su}$')
    span(x(8), x(10), -4.3, '$t_\\mathrm{hold}$')
```
